description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerGroup class within the OpenCart framework, specifically handling operations related to customer groups such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving customer group data and descriptions. It interacts with the database via queries and extends the Model class from the system engine.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Represents the customer group entity within the OpenCart Admin Model, providing methods for CRUD operations and localization handling related to customer groups.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Creates a new customer group record in the database, including its descriptions, returns the primary key id.

methods.name: editCustomerGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing customer group record identified by its ID, replacing descriptions accordingly.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroup
methods.description: Deletes the customer group record and its associated descriptions, discounts, rewards, and related tax data from the database.

methods.name: getCustomerGroup
methods.description: Fetches a customer group's data, including description in the current language.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer groups, with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCustomerGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of customer groups in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a customer group in a specified language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description records for a specific customer group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Removes all description records associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a customer group's description in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a customer group across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all customer group descriptions in a specific language.
